name: Toggle Group
description: A cluster of Toggle-styled options with roving focus, in mutually exclusive single mode or independent multiple mode.
usage:
<ToggleGroup type="single" defaultValue="left" aria-label="Text alignment">
  <ToggleGroupItem value="left">Left</ToggleGroupItem>
  <ToggleGroupItem value="center">Center</ToggleGroupItem>
  <ToggleGroupItem value="right">Right</ToggleGroupItem>
</ToggleGroup>

anatomy.description: A roving-focus container that needs an accessible name, usually through aria-label.
A Toggle-styled option; single mode exposes aria-checked, multiple mode aria-pressed.
The sm size for compact toolbars.

dos: Name the group with aria-label, since items are often icon-only.
Use type=single for mutually exclusive modes like text alignment.
Keep groups to two to five items so every option stays visible.
donts: Don't use it for settings that need explanatory text; use RadioCard or CheckboxCard.
Don't use it to submit form choices; it is a control cluster, not a fieldset.

examples.title: Single selection
examples.description: type="single" behaves like a radio group: one item stays checked at a time.

examples.title: Multiple selection
examples.description: type="multiple" lets any combination of items stay pressed, plus a compact sm size.

guidance.useWhen: Two to five related options need quick on/off switching, such as alignment or formatting controls.
guidance.avoidWhen: Options need explanatory text or there are many of them; use RadioCard, CheckboxCard, or Select instead.
guidance.behavior: Single mode keeps exactly one item checked and reports the new value; multiple mode reports the full array of pressed values. Disabled items leave the focus order and cannot be toggled.
guidance.responsive: Items wrap to the next line when the group outgrows its container.

keyboard.action: Moves focus to the group's current item.
Moves focus between items without changing the selection.

notes: Single mode exposes radio semantics (aria-checked); multiple mode exposes toggle buttons (aria-pressed).
The group needs an accessible name, usually through aria-label.

apiEntries.description:
A cluster of toggles with shared focus management. Use `type="single"` for
mutually exclusive choices and `type="multiple"` for independent ones.
A single option inside a ToggleGroup, styled to match Toggle.
